recentItems.title: Aaron Donald Returns to the Rams and Josh Jacobs Placed on the Exempt List | The NFL Report
recentItems.description:
Andrew Siciliano reports on defensive tackle Aaron Donald coming out of retirement to rejoin the Los Angeles Rams, Packers running back Josh Jacobs being placed on the Commissioner’s Exempt List, and the final week of the preseason. NFL analyst Trevor Sikkema joins to share his expectations for Donald on the Rams and what the Packers might do at running back with Josh Jacobs out.
